claim_boundary: This is an executable constraint synthesis over source-backed published/repository evidence, not a pooled cross-clade transition-rate estimate.

module_reuse_is_white_specific.reason: Three independent Chilean Mimulus gains from a yellow ancestral context all map to the pathway-specific regulatory module.

single_whole_flower_ancestral_colour.reason: Epimedium has a white ancestral inner-sepal state but a yellow ancestral petal/spur state.

universal_white_to_colour_direction.reason: Published Hydrangea stochastic maps report substantially more coloured-to-white than white-to-coloured transitions.
